passive.name: Torturer's Eye
passive.description: As the Troupe's torturer, Feitan knows exactly where it hurts. Nearby enemy champions reveal a weak point on one of their sides; striking it deals bonus true damage and grants Feitan a burst of movement speed. A new weak point appears shortly after.

weakPoint.damage: 3% (+4% per 100 bonus AD) of the target's maximum health as true damage
weakPoint.reward: +20% movement speed for 1.5s and a heal of 30 + 5 per level
weakPoint.respawn: A new weak point appears 2.25s later; it lasts 13s, or 2s while out of range

h1.name: Umbrella Thrust
h1.description: Feitan lunges a short distance in a direction and strikes with the blade hidden in his umbrella, hitting the nearest enemy and prioritising weak points. Hitting an enemy refunds part of the cooldown.

effects.refund: 50% of the cooldown if it hits an enemy

h2.name: Parasol Guard
h2.description: Feitan opens his umbrella and blocks all incoming damage and harmful effects for a moment, then thrusts in a direction, damaging and slowing the first enemy hit.

h3.name: Confession
h3.description: Feitan seizes an enemy champion and tortures them for a short time, dealing damage that grows the longer it lasts. If the victim survives the whole interrogation, Feitan learns where their allies are and reveals every enemy champion on the map. If the victim dies before it ends, nothing is revealed.

damage.baseValues: 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 per strike (5 strikes, each 25% stronger than the last)

h4.name: Pain Packer: Rising Sun
h4.description: Learning this ability unlocks a gauge that fills with the damage Feitan takes and slowly empties out of combat. On cast, Feitan wraps himself in his armour, taking reduced damage while he channels, and calls down a burning sun around him that deals damage and burns enemies. The fuller the gauge, the larger the sun and the more damage it deals.

damage.fullGauge: Up to double damage with a full gauge

lore:
Feitan Portor was born in Meteor City, the junkyard of outcasts whose people exist in no official record. As a youth he ran its streets with Phinks until a boy named Chrollo outwitted them both, and he became one of the friends who swore lifelong loyalty to him. Three years later he stood among the founding members of the Phantom Troupe as its second member, and he took part in the massacre of the Kurta Clan. The Troupe's interrogator and torturer, he is loyal to Chrollo but even more to the Spider itself, ready to put the survival of the group above anyone, its leader included.

Feitan is one of the fastest and deadliest fighters in the Troupe, a swordsman who favours striking from his enemies' blind spots with the blade hidden in his umbrella. His Nen ability, Pain Packer, stores every wound he receives and releases it as Rising Sun, a miniature sun of scorching heat that he weathers inside a protective suit of armour; the more he is hurt, the hotter it burns. Terse, cold and quick to anger, he speaks in short broken sentences and switches to a strange tongue when furious.
